protocol_note: The initial twelve-line metadata read inadvertently also exposed the heading, introduction and start of routing text. Selection decisions above use only name/description; this is a protocol deviation, not a strictly metadata-only read.

cases.reason: Product landing pages and usable web purchase paths fit the description.
Screenshot-based visual hierarchy review is a visual review of a web interface.
Overlapping RTL form labels are a focused visual correction in an existing interface.
Faithful implementation of supplied website references is explicitly included; preserve its layout.
Purposeful WebGL and web usability fall within the description.
Redesigning dashboard states affects a product interface.
Backend-only PostgreSQL optimization is explicitly outside scope.
Smart-contract security auditing does not design or review a web interface.
Standalone print design is explicitly excluded.
A backend helper rename without interface effects is a generic code change outside scope.
A generic HTTP status explanation is not web interface design, implementation or visual review.
A database migration with frontend explicitly excluded is backend-only work.
